entities.name: Eleno de Céspedes
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eleno de Céspedes, also known as Elena de Céspedes, was an Afro-Spanish surgeon and soldier. While Céspedes was assumed to be a female at birth and was initially married to a man, Céspedes later adopted a male identity and served as a soldier during the second Rebellion of the Alpujarras, eventually becoming a surgeon during peace time and marrying a woman.
